summary: The filing is an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting a routine dividend declaration by KKR Enhanced US Direct Lending Fund-L Inc., a business development company. It states a dividend of $11.03 per common share declared on August 31, 2026, payable on or about September 30, 2026, to holders of record as of August 31, 2026. No special-situation event, such as an acquisition, restructuring, or tender offer, is present. This is an ordinary distribution announcement, not a strategic corporate event. Regulatory and structural details are minimal; the filing serves solely to disclose the dividend terms and record date.
